prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a hit while turning left. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1417; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a left-turn collision. The damage to the front driver-side quarter panel, bumper bracket, and headlamp assembly is largely consistent with the impact described by the owner. Repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and headlamp, repairing the fender, and refinishing adjacent panels. Labor hours requested match the scope of the damage shown. Itemized invoices reviewed; no duplicate charges appear. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's account.
